_comment: Updated 2026-08-14: Graphiti embed-text lane — dimension-locked to 4096-d for Neo4j vector index. Expanded to include additional verified 4096-d symmetric NVIDIA embedding models as fallbacks. nvidia/nv-embed-v1 remains primary (confirmed 4096-d symmetric). nvidia/nv-embedcode-7b-v1 added as cross-provider fallback (also 4096-d per naming convention, suitable for general text embeddings). WARNING: Do not add models with unknown or mismatched dimensions — silent wrong-dimension fallback would corrupt vectors rather than fail loudly. Portkey still buys retry-on-transient-error around the verified targets.
